name: Cycle of Rebirth
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield seeks Gaea seeds to heal Stonetalon. She asks the Horde to gather them from Mirkfallon Lake, so she can bless them and restore the mountain’s damaged soil.

sections.title: A Scarred Wilderness
sections.body: Logging and clashes between rival factions have scarred Stonetalon’s peaks. Forests have been scorched, cut down, or reduced to ash. For the tauren at Sun Rock Retreat, the swift ruin of the natural world is a grievous wound. Shamans such as Tammra Windfield turn to the Earthmother’s renewing cycle as they work to mend the land.

sections.title: The Seeds of Mirkfallon
sections.body: Tammra seeks rare Gaea seeds along Mirkfallon Lake, north of Sun Rock Retreat. Sturdy seed pods grow on the banks by the water, holding a resilience found only in Stonetalon. Once gathered, Tammra gives each kernel an ancestral shamanistic blessing. The blessing awakens its power and hastens its growth.

faq.q: What is the purpose of collecting Gaea seeds?
faq.answer: Gaea seeds carry the vitality Tammra Windfield needs to restore damaged land. She blesses them with the Earthmother’s power so they can sprout quickly and replenish parts of Stonetalon ruined by industry and war.

faq.q: Where are the Gaea seeds located?
faq.answer: Gaea seeds grow along Mirkfallon Lake’s shoreline, north of Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Look in the dirt near the water’s edge around the lake.
Tammra Windfield is a tauren shaman at Sun Rock Retreat. She works to heal Stonetalon with Earthmother blessings after logging and wartime conflict devastate the land.

faq.q: What does Tammra do once the seeds are returned?
faq.answer: When Tammra receives the ten Gaea seeds, she chants over them and fills them with shamanistic energy. This quickens their growth and prepares them for planting in devastated places.

faq.q: What quest follows Cycle of Rebirth?
aliases: next quest after cycle of rebirth
what is after cycle of rebirth
faq.answer: After Cycle of Rebirth comes New Life. The blessed seeds are carried into the devastated Charred Vale to begin restoring plant life.

faq.q: Why is the land of Stonetalon in need of healing?
faq.answer: Warfare and extensive clear-cutting by industrial lumber ventures have damaged the Stonetalon Mountains. Scorched wastelands and scarred valleys struggle to regrow on their own.

angles.text: Tammra’s work follows the shaman’s calling to mend ecological imbalance. The spirits and the Earthmother can restore what industrial exploitation tears down.
For the Shu'halo, healing Stonetalon’s wounded soil is a spiritual duty to the Earthmother. It answers the damage caused by reckless logging and factional warfare.
Druids may recognize the focus on natural cycles and cultivating seeds. Restoring barren earth echoes Cenarion stewardship.
